args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (error rate ~18%). Rolled all regions back to v2.3.0, the most recent healthy production release. The dedicated rollback endpoint returned 503 on repeated attempts, so the rollback was executed via deploy of v2.3.0. Rollout succeeded; all regions now report v2.3.0.
args.title: checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy — rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Summary:

- **Diagnosis**: checkout-api's latest deploy, **v2.3.1**, was unhealthy in all production regions (error rate ~18%). The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
- **Rollback**: The dedicated `rollback` endpoint returned 503 on four attempts, so I executed the rollback via a **deploy of v2.3.0** to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). No change-manager approval was required since v2.3.0 was previously healthy in production.
- **Verification**: All three regions are now on v2.3.0 and reporting **healthy** with error rate down to **0.2%**.
- **Incident**: Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api, describing the failed deploy, the rollback, the rollback-endpoint outage workaround, and the recovery. The on-call engineer was paged.
